description: The third-party data upstreams approved in PLAN §2 (D-5). A table licensed MIT or Apache-2.0 lives under data/thirdparty/<upstream id>/ with the upstream's licence, has a '## <name>' section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md that names the file, and the upstream's licence text in licenses/<upstream id>.txt, which the build copies into the jar's META-INF/licenses/. An MIT source record names its upstream as notice. Checked by the data validator (T3.0j, REQ-DATA-05).
